executive_summary: WS-LAB-028 scored 92.3/100 (CRITICAL): likely active ransomware intrusion. Strongest signals: shadow copy / backup deletion, boot recovery inhibition, security / backup service tampering (MITRE T1490, T1489, T1562.001, T1059.001, T1027). All containment steps below await human approval.
incident_narrative: 20:41:40 UTC - Suspicious execution chain & discovery: Office app spawned a shell: powerpnt.exe → powershell.exe | 21:01:38 UTC - Suspicious privilege escalation: SeLoadDriverPrivilege used by winhlp41.exe (user avery.patel) | 21:10:33 UTC - Security / backup service tampering: Stop/disable commands against 5 security/backup/database service(s): MSExchangeIS, MSSQLSERVER, SQLWriter, Sense, WinDefend | 21:12:46 UTC - Shadow copy / backup deletion: `wmic.exe shadowcopy delete /nointeractive` (parent winhlp41.exe) | 21:13:06 UTC - Boot recovery inhibition: `bcdedit.exe /set {default} recoveryenabled no`

key_evidence.statement: Shadow copy / backup deletion (severity 1.0): `wmic.exe shadowcopy delete /nointeractive` (parent winhlp41.exe); `wbadmin.exe delete catalog -quiet` (parent winhlp41.exe)
Boot recovery inhibition (severity 1.0): `bcdedit.exe /set {default} recoveryenabled no`; `bcdedit.exe /set {default} bootstatuspolicy ignoreallfailures`
Security / backup service tampering (severity 1.0): Stop/disable commands against 5 security/backup/database service(s): MSExchangeIS, MSSQLSERVER, SQLWriter, Sense, WinDefend
Suspicious execution chain & discovery (severity 1.0): Office app spawned a shell: powerpnt.exe → powershell.exe; Encoded PowerShell command line (1x)
Suspicious privilege escalation (severity 0.7): SeLoadDriverPrivilege used by winhlp41.exe (user avery.patel); 1 process(es) from a user-writable path running at High/System integrity

mitre_techniques.name: Impair Defenses: Disable or Modify Tools

recommended_actions.title: Network-isolate the host via EDR containment
recommended_actions.description: Use the EDR console to contain the host (keeps EDR channel). Affects the user; approval required.
recommended_actions.rationale: Recommended by playbook for observed indicators (I4, I5, I6, I8).

recommended_actions.title: Preserve evidence: memory image, EDR telemetry and Windows logs
recommended_actions.description: Collect before any clean-up; record chain of custody.
recommended_actions.rationale: Recommended by playbook for observed indicators (I4, I5, I6, I8).

recommended_actions.title: Hunt for the same process / command / account on other hosts
recommended_actions.description: Scope the incident; ransomware usually stages on several hosts.
recommended_actions.rationale: Recommended by playbook for observed indicators (I4, I5, I6, I8).

recommended_actions.title: Disable / force credential reset for the user account and revoke sessions
recommended_actions.description: Coordinate with identity team; confirm it is not a service account.
recommended_actions.rationale: Recommended by playbook for observed indicators (I4, I5, I6, I8).

recommended_actions.title: Block the suspicious process hash/path and its C2 destinations
recommended_actions.description: Add EDR/app-control block and firewall/proxy block for observed destinations.
recommended_actions.rationale: Recommended by playbook for observed indicators (I4, I5, I6, I8).

recommended_actions.title: Verify offline/immutable backups for host and reachable shares
recommended_actions.description: Confirm last good restore point exists and is isolated from the network.
recommended_actions.rationale: Recommended by playbook for observed indicators (I4, I5, I6, I8).

recommended_actions.title: Pause backup retention/deletion jobs that could overwrite good restore points
recommended_actions.description: Temporary change to backup schedules; approval from backup owner.
recommended_actions.rationale: Recommended by playbook for observed indicators (I4, I5, I6, I8).

recommended_actions.title: Restore and re-enable security agent / stopped backup services from management console
recommended_actions.description: Re-enable tamper protection; confirm no approved change ticket explains the stop.
recommended_actions.rationale: Recommended by playbook for observed indicators (I4, I5, I6, I8).

recommended_actions.title: Escalate to incident response lead and start reporting workflow
recommended_actions.description: Notify IR lead; follow internal, legal and Cyber Centre/CISA reporting guidance. Do not pay or contact the attacker.
recommended_actions.rationale: Recommended by playbook for observed indicators (I4, I5, I6, I8).

recommended_actions.title: Decode and review encoded PowerShell in an isolated sandbox (do not execute)
recommended_actions.description: Static decoding only; identify download URLs and dropped files.
recommended_actions.rationale: Recommended by playbook for observed indicators (I4, I5, I6, I8).

false_positive_considerations: Possible benign explanations: backup software rotating shadow copies; approved maintenance stopping services; management agents or power-user scripts using encoded PowerShell.
